title: Cap Chaos top conveyor — format v2
description: The LAYOUT of the top conveyor (GDD R1–R4, §6.2b), shared by every level that names it (`conveyor` in level.schema.json): one LOOP and three FEEDER conveyors — right, left, middle, in that order — each a spline of nodes the way ConveyorKit stores a conveyor, plus the rule numbers (rows, bottles per row, pick zone, where each feeder's queue joins). No bottles: a level supplies those, for the first N feeders it uses. One file per layout in Assets/CapsChaos/Content/Configs/ConveyorConfig/<id>.json. Coordinates are BOARD units (x right, z away from the player). Structural checks live here; V8 (pick zone, merge points) and V9 (splines) are ConveyorValidator. Format v1 (preset shapes) no longer loads.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension. Convention: <shape>_<rows>_<feeders>f, e.g. oval_16_1f.

rows.description: Rows of belt round the loop. Track position 0 is the first row of the pick zone (the front edge, in front of the slots); positions grow in the direction of travel.

pickRows.description: Rows of the pick zone, track positions 0..pickRows-1. V8: rows ≥ 2 × pickRows + 6.

scale.description: How big the belts and the bottles on them are drawn (1 = full size: 4 tracks 0.42 apart). The knots stay where they are; a long loop that must fit the screen takes a smaller scale. Drawing only — the rules never read it.

loop.description: The closed loop the bottles ride, clockwise seen from above. Its FIRST node is track position 0 — where the pick zone starts; the rows stand evenly along the spline from there.

feeders.description: Exactly three feeder conveyors, in this order: right, left, middle. A level uses the first N (1 = right, 2 = right + left, 3 = all); the others are not drawn. A queue joins the loop a whole row at a time: mergeAt is its entrance, and its front row steps onto the free belt row nearest it (within 2 rows either way, outside the pick zone).

side.description: Must match the feeder's place in the array.

mergeAt.description: Track position the feeder joins at. V8: outside the pick zone, one feeder per position.

nodes.description: The feeder's open spline, far end (off-screen) first; its last node is where it lands on the loop. The queue's head row waits where it is a bottle clear of the loop.

z.description: Board units, + away from the player.

yRotation.description: Heading of the belt at this knot, degrees round Y: 0 = +z, 90 = +x, 180 = toward the player. A smooth knot's handles run along it, sized from the distance to its neighbours.

tangentMode.description: 0 = smooth (Bezier along yRotation), 1 = sharp corner (Linear). As ConveyorKit's TangentMode.
